Basic ATC

Gabung ke base

Instruction to enter the circuit on the base leg, a perpendicular segment to final approach before landing.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Gabung ke base?

In this glossary, Gabung ke base refers to: Instruction to enter the circuit on the base leg, a perpendicular segment to final approach before landing.

How is Gabung ke base used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Tower: N932RT, gabung ke base kiri runway 27, diizinkan mendarat."

Why does Gabung ke base matter in aviation?

Gabung ke base matters because it supports clear communication in Basic ATC contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Who uses Gabung ke base?

Gabung ke base is mainly used by Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew.

What category does Gabung ke base belong to?

In this glossary, Gabung ke base is grouped under Basic ATC. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ICAO Doc 9432, FAA PCG and published by Protermify Aviation as a static aviation reference page.

Definition

Instruction to enter the circuit on the base leg, a perpendicular segment to final approach before landing.

Operational example

Tower: N932RT, join left base runway 27, cleared to land.

Localized term

Gabung ke base

Localized example

Tower: N932RT, gabung ke base kiri runway 27, diizinkan mendarat.
